GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Customer email summarizing a completed visit from the tune-up steps, findings and approvals. Saved on the work order. Called from RLM_HVAC_AI.summarizeVisit.

templateVersions.content:
Write the visit summary email Brightline Home Comfort sends a homeowner after today's visit. Use only the facts below. Start with "Hi" and the customer's first name. In 80 to 140 words of plain language, cover what we checked on the tune-up (with any readings worth sharing), what we found and fixed, anything they approved today (repairs or agreement changes, by name), anything to keep an eye on or do (such as changing a filter), and the next visit date if there is one. No prices, no internal notes, no promises. End with a new line that says "Brightline Home Comfort". Reply with the email body only.
{!$Input:Context}
